title: lasianthera javanica
intro: Lasianthera javanica, commonly known as Java tea or Java plum, is a plant species native to Southeast Asia. It is valued for its medicinal properties and health benefits, which include lowering blood pressure, reducing inflammation, and acting as an antioxidant, thereby protecting against oxidative stress and cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Lasianthera javanica include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antidiabetic properties, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine for treating various ailments. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and health benefits.
